payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged 4a9430a). DevTools event feed (frick-store DevToolsEventStore over the migrated devtools_events table) + facade getters (recent_error_events, idempotency_cache_stats); real /_frick/inspect/devtools/events|/events/:id|/summary routes; diagnostics.rs recentErrors + idempotency stats now populated (replaced the FR-249 defaults). /analytics/summary returns a well-formed empty admin summary (analytics ingestion worker is a later story). Emitters into request/job handlers are a follow-up (feed is seedable + live-tested).
